tips_en: Start with the NeoHorse-1 paper, as it introduces the most conceptually novel contribution—a concrete recursive self-improvement loop driven by a routing harness—that has broad implications for agentic LLM training and ties directly into the agentic themes of Gander. Read Gander next to see how intrinsic agentic capabilities (full-duplex interactivity, Brain–Cerebellum collaboration) are realized in a deployed multimodal system. Save AuK for last unless your focus is specifically speech synthesis, though it shares multimodal-unification themes with Gander.
tips_zh: 建议首先阅读 NeoHorse-1 论文，因为它提出了最具概念新颖性的贡献——通过路由机制实现的递归自我改进循环，对智能体式大语言模型训练有广泛影响，并与 Gander 的智能体主题直接相关。其次阅读 Gander，了解全双工交互、脑-小脑协作等内在智能体能力如何在实际多模态系统中实现。除非你专注于语音合成，否则将 AuK 放在最后阅读，不过它与 Gander 共享多模态统一的主题。
